fac_building_lookup.name: fac_building_lookup
fac_building_lookup.body_sql:
SELECT
  `FAC_BUILDING`.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
  NULLIF(TRIM(`FAC_BUILDING`.`BUILDING_NUMBER`), '') AS `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM(`FAC_BUILDING`.`BUILDING_NAME`), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(`FAC_BUILDING`.`BUILDING_NAME_LONG`), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(`fac_building`.`BUILDING_NAME`), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(`buildings`.`BUILDING_NAME`), '')
  ) AS `BUILDING_NAME`
FROM `fac_building`
LEFT JOIN `buildings`
  ON NULLIF(TRIM(`fac_building`.`BUILDING_NUMBER`), '') = NULLIF(TRIM(`buildings`.`BUILDING_NUMBER`), '')
fac_building_lookup.description: Building lookup table exposing building key, building number and building name to verify or join building metadata to room rows.
